page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with a short centred block of lines at its end, followed by a centred Greek motto and a woodcut ornament. Page number at top right. Running head at top centre.

main_text.p: Nutritur deinceps & augetur in utero fœtus, sanguine materno superfluo, à natura ad id deputato: qui Menstruus dicitur, ob menstruum illius in fœminis generationi aptis, sed nondum uterum gerentibus, excretionem.

Absolviturq; ita humanus fœtus in utero materno usq; ad mensem à conceptione septimum. Post quod tempus grandior jam & maturus exitum magno conatu molitur, secundinaq; membranam quâ circumtegitur rumpendo, foràs editur Homo μικρόκοσμος : in cujus usum aliæ omnes creaturæ hactenus dictæ à Deo initio rerum creatarum conditæ, illiusq; imperio subditæ fuerunt.

page.notes: The orange blotch over the word "gerentibus" (between "gerentibu" and "s") is a stain, not a reference mark, so the word is read as "gerentibus". The Greek motto "Πάντος δόξα Θεῷ." is only partly legible at the first word; the reading "Πάντος" is a best guess at the letters. The woodcut ornament below the motto is not text and is left out. The word "μικρόκοσμος" is set in Greek type and is read from the scan with some uncertainty about its ligatures.
